name: me-mark-everything
title: Mark Everything
description: Search, save, and edit bookmarks in your local ME library. Requires Mark Everything to be installed and configured separately.
author: roy

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Bookmarks
commands.subtitle: ME
commands.description: Search your ME library; edit bookmarks inline with configurable shortcuts

commands.name: save
commands.title: Save Bookmark
commands.subtitle: ME
commands.description: Save bookmarks and their details to your local ME library.

preferences.name: discoveryPath
preferences.title: Helper Discovery Record
preferences.description: Optional absolute helper-install.json path; leave blank to use the installed ME (me-raindrop).

preferences.name: shortcutOpen
preferences.title: Shortcut: Open in Browser
preferences.description: Use cmd, ctrl, opt, shift and a key, e.g. ctrl+shift+x. Use none to disable. Reopen the command after changes. Additional shortcut; Return remains available.

preferences.name: shortcutCopy
preferences.title: Shortcut: Copy URL
preferences.description: Use cmd, ctrl, opt, shift and a key, e.g. ctrl+shift+x. Use none to disable. Reopen the command after changes. Additional shortcut; cmd+Return remains available when this is the second action.

preferences.name: shortcutDetails
preferences.title: Shortcut: Show Details
preferences.description: Use cmd, ctrl, opt, shift and a key, e.g. ctrl+shift+x. Use none to disable. Reopen the command after changes.

preferences.name: shortcutEdit
preferences.title: Shortcut: Edit in Raycast
preferences.description: Use cmd, ctrl, opt, shift and a key, e.g. ctrl+shift+x. Use none to disable. Reopen the command after changes.

preferences.name: shortcutTrash
preferences.title: Shortcut: Move to Trash
preferences.description: Use cmd, ctrl, opt, shift and a key, e.g. ctrl+shift+x. Use none to disable. Reopen the command after changes. The confirmation dialog still appears.

preferences.name: shortcutManager
preferences.title: Shortcut: Open in ME Manager
preferences.description: Use cmd, ctrl, opt, shift and a key, e.g. ctrl+shift+x. Use none to disable. Reopen the command after changes.

preferences.name: shortcutRefresh
preferences.title: Shortcut: Refresh / Reload
preferences.description: Use cmd, ctrl, opt, shift and a key, e.g. ctrl+shift+x. Use none to disable. Reopen the command after changes.

preferences.name: shortcutSave
preferences.title: Shortcut: Save Bookmark / Changes
preferences.description: Use cmd, ctrl, opt, shift and a key, e.g. ctrl+shift+x. Use none to disable. Reopen the command after changes. Additional shortcut; cmd+Return remains available.

preferences.name: shortcutAddUrl
preferences.title: Shortcut: Add Another URL
preferences.description: Use cmd, ctrl, opt, shift and a key. Use none to disable. Reopen the command after changes.

preferences.name: shortcutRemoveUrl
preferences.title: Shortcut: Remove URL
preferences.description: Use cmd, ctrl, opt, shift and a key. Use none to disable. Reopen the command after changes.
